records.description: CEBU CITY, Philippines (Sept. 21, 2011) A fan holds a sign for Musician 3rd Class Gabriel Brown during a performance of the U.S. 7th Fleet Band, Orient Express, at Fuente Osmena Circle in Cebu City. The band is visiting Cebu City as part of the U.S. Embassy's program "America In 3D", a program designed to share U.S. culture, values and services in the Philippines. (U.S. Navy photo by Musician 3rd Class Zachary Buckwash/Released)

records.description:
Grapes Sold on the Streets of Cebu City
Grapes sold on the streets of Cebu City are among the growing variety of street products popular with both locals and tourists. These are often displayed on sidewalk vendor stalls or pushcarts in busy areas such as Colon Street, Fuente Osmeña, and other bustling streets in the city.
